font.family: Lalezar (hero word, as embedded glyph paths) + Vazirmatn 700 (caption)
font.reason: The effect depends on very heavy strokes acting as the viewport; Lalezar is the heaviest single-weight Persian display face in the kit (no fake bold needed). Caption is a neutral product-UI voice, Vazirmatn variable 700.

comps.translatedSummary: SCALE -> «مقیاس»; caption 'TEXT AS MASK' -> «متن به‌عنوان ماسک»

rtlDecisions.why: Translated idiomatically; caption lost letterSpacing:10 and uppercase (break Persian joining); hierarchy kept by size/weight/colour.
An SVG used as mask-image cannot load page web fonts; the word is shaped once with HarfBuzz from Lalezar and embedded as outline paths (maskGlyphs.ts), vector-crisp at 26x.

rtlDecisions.what: Dashboard drift translateX +110 -> -110 (20-100f) and ease to 0 (100-130f)
rtlDecisions.why: Panning follows reading direction: now -110 -> +110 via dir(); same speed, frames and easing.
Shared fixture is LTR-only and read-only; copied as MirroredDashboard with direction:rtl (sidebar right, search left via marginInlineStart, grid reads RTL).
Hand-picked origin (L stem 61.5%) is invalid for the new word; moved to 47.8% 46%, inside the solid alef stroke so the hole grows evenly and the cover layer finishes the take-over.

rtlDecisions.what: Scale 1->26, bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), 1/S counter-scale, cover fade 0.25-0.9, frame beats 20/100/130
rtlDecisions.why: Physics of a zoom and the timing design are direction-neutral.
Centred, symmetric composition; vertical placement re-balanced (baseline 640, size 500 px/em) so the heavy body band shows dashboard content like the original.

rasterTextHandling: No raster text. Dashboard is text-free placeholder bars. Mask word is vector paths from Lalezar.
concerns: Registry duration is 20f; design is 150f, rendered with --duration 150. Original reference render only exists for 20 frames, so only f10 had an original comparison; later beats compared against the design in the source prompt.
Lalezar's tall alef and descending س make the word taller than the Latin original; the dashboard is only visible in the central body band, same limitation as the original placeholder content.
